modules.hypothesis: Narrow retrieval and resume packets reduce repeated reads and context growth without losing required evidence.
modules.primaryMetric: Repeated source reads per completed task

routingPolicy.currentDefault: Stay direct for a handful of short sources.
activateWhen: A handoff or compaction needs a resume packet
skipWhen: Roughly four or fewer short sources
One direct read already returns the required evidence

latestRevision.change: Added a direct-work fast path for small tasks and reserved the full workflow for broad or handoff-prone work.

orchestration.role: Reduce and preserve the working set before broad execution.
orchestration.receives: Task graph, source scope, required evidence, and open decisions
orchestration.handsOff: Compact working set and resumable state packet

modules.hypothesis: Bounded batches of independent reads reduce wall-clock time and round trips while preserving final evidence quality.
modules.primaryMetric: Tool round trips per completed task

routingPolicy.currentDefault: Use direct reads for small batches; batching is opt-in for larger independent sets.
activateWhen: Roughly eight or more comparable independent operations
A strict compact return shape is available
skipWhen: One direct command can return all required fields

latestRevision.change: Raised the provisional batching threshold and made direct reads the default for the tested small-workload shape.

orchestration.role: Run a larger independent read set after the coordinator proves the calls do not depend on one another.
orchestration.receives: Bounded independent operations and a strict return contract
orchestration.handsOff: Reduced evidence packet with provenance and failures

modules.hypothesis: Observe-act-verify loops catch visual and state regressions that click-only browser workflows miss.

orchestration.role: Own visible browser interaction and verify the resulting state before returning control.
orchestration.receives: Target state, stable interaction boundary, and completion checks

modules.hypothesis: Dependency-aware routing shortens the critical path only when workstreams are independent and ownership does not overlap.

orchestration.role: Choose direct work, deterministic batching, specialist streams, or a handoff from the dependency graph.
orchestration.receives: User outcome, dependencies, shared decisions, and authorization boundaries
orchestration.handsOff: Execution graph with one owner and explicit workstream contracts

modules.hypothesis: Stable baseline-versus-candidate comparisons improve task quality more reliably than anecdotal prompt changes.

orchestration.role: Compare completed baseline and candidate runs, then decide whether guidance should change.
orchestration.receives: Representative traces, success criteria, and quality guardrails
orchestration.handsOff: Keep, revise, retire, or collect-more decision

modules.hypothesis: Distinct tool contracts reduce first-choice routing errors, unnecessary retries, and oversized results.

orchestration.role: Refine ambiguous tools and routing boundaries revealed by traces or failed workstreams.
orchestration.receives: Routing failures, overlapping contracts, and oversized results
orchestration.handsOff: Simplified tool descriptions, inputs, returns, and fallback rules
